description: Connects a whole domain to The Command Center website. Apply at the zone apex (no host). Points @ at The Command Center apex redirect IPs (A records; these replace registrar forwarding and other A records on @), which send visitors to https://www with the path kept, and points www at customers.tcommcen.com (CNAME) with the Cloudflare for SaaS ownership TXT. Pass groupId=txt for the ACME TXT at _acme-challenge.www, or groupId=dcv for the delegated DCV CNAME. Callers must pass one groupId. Synchronous apply redirects back to The Command Center.
variableDescription: %ownership%: Cloudflare for SaaS ownership_verification value for www, written verbatim at _cf-custom-hostname.www. %certificate%: ACME DNS-01 token for www, written verbatim at _acme-challenge.www (group txt only). %dcvid%: single DNS label of the zone DCV delegation id; the CNAME target is www.%fqdn%.%dcvid%.dcv.cloudflare.com (group dcv only). %fqdn% is built in and equals the domain when no host is passed.
